title: Quick Fried Syrian Black Pudding Fritters
description: A salty, tender, and nostalgic Syrian dish featuring black pudding, deep-fried to perfection, suitable for those following a Whole30 diet.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, crumble the black pudding into small pieces.
Add the breadcrumbs, egg, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Fold in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Heat about 1/2 inch (1 cm) of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat until it reaches 375°F (190°C).
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the black pudding mixture into the hot oil, forming small fritters.
Fry the fritters for about 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fried fritters hot and enjoy!
